car.title: Car Insurance B2C Journey
car.desc: In this project I got a document from the client showcasing some designs they like. I reviewed the ideas and merged some together, while still making sure the design can be implemented in our platform.
car.desc2: This is a general car insurance journey, where the user can add their car's info, their personal info, and get an insurance plan depending on the given data.
car.desc3: Unfortunately I can only show the original design blurred, but even this way you can see I shortened the form to make it easier to use.

travel.title: Travel Insurance B2C Journey
travel.desc: For this project I had to design a Travel and a Home insurance process for a B2C application. Both journeys are very similar in design, and I decided to show Travel.
travel.desc2: This is also a pretty simple app, separating the the form into smaller steps, where the user can add personal info, data about the trip itself and get a personalized plan at the end.
travel.desc3: I had to take into consideration the special platform we are using for development and also the client's exisiting apps and brand identity.

pet.title: Pet Insurance B2C Journey
pet.desc: This project is very close to my heart, it was one of the first design project I got. I'm very proud of it in general, but especially, because I put it together on a weekend, and the client chose my design over an actual design company's suggestion.
pet.desc2: I also created a prototype for this one, and implemented the design myself. I really loved the topic of it as well, let's be honest, insurance can be boring sometimes, but pets are fun!
pet.desc3: As you can already tell, I got some freedom in this project, compared to the others. I still had to make sure it's compatible with our environment.
pet.desc4: *The icons I used are not mine!

uw.title: Underwriting B2B Journey
uw.desc: I was asked to redesign a complex underwriting application, as the previous look & feel was obviously not the best. Working together with Business and System Analysts, and creating the design in a test environment to ensure its feasibility, I managed to prepare something that the clients really liked.
uw.desc2: I am also very proud of the result myself, I shortened and reorganized the form and created more contrast, highlighting important inputs and sections for the user.

habit.title: Habit Tracker App
habit.desc: This was a hobby project my manager asked me to help him with. I really enjoyed it, I got full freedom, but looking back on the design now, I feel like it could've been more professional and precise.
habit.desc2: There wasn't much pressure here and as soon as we had our ideas put into the design we went onto implementing, so the design file itself wasn't the priority.
